notes.help_text:
📝 *MIRAIRO YEZVINYORWA*

*Wedzera chinyorwa:*
{{prefix}}addnote <mashoko>
{{prefix}}newnote <mashoko>
{{prefix}}makenote <mashoko>

*Tora chinyorwa chakati:*
{{prefix}}getnote <nhamba>
{{prefix}}listnote <nhamba>

*Tora zvinyorwa zvako zvose:*
{{prefix}}getnotes
{{prefix}}getallnotes
{{prefix}}listnotes

*Gadzirisa chinyorwa:*
{{prefix}}updatenote <nhamba> <mashoko matsva>

*Bvisa chinyorwa chakati:*
{{prefix}}delnote <nhamba>
{{prefix}}deletenote <nhamba>
{{prefix}}removenote <nhamba>

*Bvisa zvinyorwa zvako zvose:*
{{prefix}}delallnotes
{{prefix}}removeallnotes
{{prefix}}deleteallnotes

_Zvinyorwa ndezvako pachako uye zvinochengetwa zvakachengeteka mudatabase._

settings.antiedit_options:
❌ Ndapota sarudza: *on*, *off*, *indm* (DM chete), kana *inchat* (muchat chete)

*Mazvinyorwa akakodzera azvino:*
• *indm* - Yambiro muDM yemuridzi chete (default)
• *inchat* - Yambiro muchat iyoyo chete
• *on* - Yambiro muDM nemuchat
• *off* - Dzima anti-edit

badwords.menu:
📋 *Kutonga Mashoko Akaipa*

*Kushandisa:*
• *.badwords add <shoko>* - Wedzera shoko rakaipa
• *.badwords add <shoko1> <shoko2>* - Wedzera mashoko akawanda
• *.badwords remove <shoko>* - Bvisa shoko
• *.badwords list* - Ratidza mashoko ese akaipa
• *.badwords clear* - Bvisa mashoko ese akaipa
• *.badwords default* - Isa mashoko akaipa edefault ({{defaultCount}})

*Runyorwa rwazvino ({{count}}):*
{{list}}

❌ Ndapota ipa shoko/mashoko ekuwedzera!
